# NPI Number Lookup

> A comprehensive NPI number lookup and physician directory service for finding doctors, dentists, and medical professionals across the USA by specialty and credentials.

NPI Number Lookup provides a searchable database of National Provider Identifiers (NPIs) for healthcare professionals in the United States. The platform enables patients and healthcare organizations to verify physician credentials, practice details, and medical specialties across all major disciplines.

## Key Topics

- NPI Number
- Physician Directory
- Doctor Search
- Medical Specialties
- Healthcare Database
- USA Doctors
- Dentist Directory
- Medical Professionals
- Anesthesiology
- Cardiology
- Dermatology
- Emergency Medicine
- Family Medicine
- Gastroenterology
- Internal Medicine

## NPI Lookup & Search

- [NPI Number Lookup for Doctors & Physicians in USA](https://npino.com): Primary NPI lookup tool for physicians and doctors across USA with practice details, credentials, and medical specialty information.
